5 times to use Kiro Supervised mode instead of Autopilot

Five times to switch Kiro to Supervised mode.

1. Production code - If a mistake is expensive, approve each step.
2. Unfamiliar repo - When you don't know the codebase yet.
3. Database changes - Review every migration before it runs.
4. Security code - Auth and secrets deserve a second look.
5. Learning - Watch each step to learn how Kiro works.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/ide/chat/autopilot/
